profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | Software Developer @ USAA
profile.summary:
At USAA, my role as Lead Software Engineer within the Financial Advice and Life Insurance areas has been marked by leading a dedicated team in the creation of multi-layered web applications and intricate backend microservices. With the help of my team, we've employed agile methodologies and DevOps practices to deliver software that upholds the stringent compliance standards of the finance industry.

My technical proficiency encompasses Java enterprise service development, event-driven architectures using Kafka, and database design with DB2. As a proponent of continuous integration and delivery, I've contributed to building robust monitoring and alerting systems that enhance digital responsiveness and operational efficiency, aligning with USAA's commitment to innovation and quality.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software developer and lead working within the Financial Advice area and Life Insurance area. Lead a team of 7-10 developers to deliver multi layer Web Applications and complex backend microservices using agile practices and DEVOP development practices to ensure high quality software that met the SDLC compliant requirements of the highly regulated financial institute of financial advice and Life Insurance.

Skills ranged from Java development of enterprise RESTful APIs using Spring Boot and JBoss, event driven architectures utilizing Kafka and Kafka Connect, database design using DB2 and couchbase datasources, rapid development and release using CICD, building out monitoring and alerting systems to ensure immediate awareness of issues, troubleshooting complicated new and old systems, building supportable systems that were scalable, highly available, and fault tolerant.
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Kafka · Java · Prometheus · Spring Boot · Spring Framework · Spring Batch · Spring Data · Spring · Elastic Stack (ELK) · Revielle · REST APIs · Event Driven Architecture

positions.title: Digital Oilfield Engineer
positions.description:
Software Developer and Technical Lead which focused on PE functional software development consulting on a enterprise software solution. Activities involved planning, designing, developing, testing, and deploying a vendor software solution integrated with internal environment. The automated Workflow System (Integrated Field Management) developed in .NET with additional modules/workflows built using a proprietary software that focused on Reservoir and Well Physics based models that were automatically callibrated, identified optimization opportunity, and identify leading constraints. The underlying technology uses Well and System modeling software called Petroleum Experts Integrated Production Modeling (IPM). 

Provided technical leadership for an Agile Houston based team that provided a Software + Petroleum Engineering guidance on using field surveillance and optimization software across the enterprise. Skills included .NET development,  project planning, sprint planning, solution architecture, integration with internal environment, testing, packaging, enterprise deployment, end user and team training, functional understanding of petorleum engineering, and cross team mentoring. 

Technologies based on Windows environment - C#, .NET, SQL Development, SQL Server 2008, 2012, 2014, Windows Server 2008-2012, TFS, WIX, OSiSoft PI, AF, Energy Components (Oracle), Petroleum Experts Integrated Production Modeling (IPM), Integrated Field Management (IFM), and Integrated Visual Management (IVM)
